figuren.name: Herr Lesefrieden

auszuege: ROW1 TOP identity01: fussy retired night-reader, very broad LOW ink puddle with TWO short crown lobes, cream pinstriped pajama COLLAR and short OPEN burgundy quilted dressing-gown lapels, tiny soft cream nightcap with burgundy pompom on one side.
Holds SAME small blue chipped enamel tea mug in both states, one broad ivory front tooth and two little lower teeth in both.

LEFT A: shoulders/lobes curl protectively upward, huge uneven wide eyes WHITE/red/black pupils looking upward with startled confusion, lower lip trembles into jagged clench, both goo hands clutch mug at belly.

RIGHT B: broad goo lobes tense outward but inside cell, heavy eyebrows compressed DOWN, glaring red pupils forward, mouth huge skewed triangular snarl showing same tooth arrangement; one goo hand firmly holds mug against body, other closes into fist at OWN waist, no striking or reaching.
Same outfit/nightcap/mug/color/identity.

figuren.name: Herr Hausverstand

auszuege: ROW3 BOTTOM identity03 fastidious home custodian, compact round ink blob with small curled top tuft, faded moss-green knitted sleeveless house-vest collar over ivory pajama collar, mustard knitted sleep cap.
SAME fat crumpled blank newspaper roll hugged under own arm in both states, round brass pince-nez and one gold tooth among sparse ivory teeth.

LEFT A: body flattens a bit, eyes almost pop white with red irises/pupils upward, mouth long downward bent lower-lip pout exposing gold tooth, hands grip newspaper as comfort blanket, confused offense rather than cute sadness.

RIGHT B: body puffs within same cell size, intense red gaze through pince-nez, huge clenched uneven-tooth grin-snarl with gold tooth visible, one goo finger planted on OWN rolled newspaper as if quoting rules, no pointing at other actor.
Identical cap/vest/glasses/newspaper, clear same resident.
